description: This Java class manages serial port connections, including opening, configuring, and closing serial ports, as well as sending commands through the port. It implements a singleton pattern for port management and interacts with binary protocol handling.

classes.name: PortHolder
classes.description: Manages serial port connection, configuration, and communication, implementing singleton pattern.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens a serial port with specified data and connection state listeners, and initiates protocol connection.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Configures and opens the serial port, then establishes binary protocol communication.

methods.name: setupPort
methods.description: Configures serial port parameters such as RTS, DTR, baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and flow control.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port connection safely.

methods.name: packAndSend
methods.description: Sends a command through the protocol, blocking until the connection is available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PortHolder.
